MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The caliper felt useful because I could measure screw diameters and check sizes for my metric screws and push-on washers.",
    "Recommending measuring equipment recognized that my fastener purchases can create a need to check fit before assembling things."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The SAE nut assortment was close in purpose, but it did not match the M3, M4, and M5 metric screws I recently selected.",
    "The tubing, wire connectors, and electronic cleaner assumed an electrical task that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The cutting wheels and endoscope require specific tasks I do not currently have, while ten packs of glue exceed my needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in fasteners and magnetic hooks seemed to be stretched into interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "Screws described as being for electronics seemed to suggest wiring work, although my interest was in fastening and fit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Metric sizing matters to me; a similar-looking fastener is not useful if it does not fit my existing hardware.",
    "My recent choices center on mechanical fastening and hanging items, so a clear connection to those tasks matters more than a general DIY connection.",
    "I rarely choose something without an immediate use, especially specialized tools or large quantities of consumables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical hardware interests but expanded them into unrelated workshop tasks instead of staying close to fit, fastening, and hanging needs."
}
